meaning.en: CCS Combo 2 connector (IEC 62196-3, Type 2 with two DC contacts), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: CCS-Combo-2-Stecker (IEC 62196-3, Typ 2 mit zwei DC-Kontakten), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: IEC 62196-3 itself not consulted (paywalled). Layout checked against two public drawings on Wikimedia Commons, retrieved 2026-10-21: "File:IEC 62196 Type 2 (M, DC, CCS Combo 2).svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; male CCS Combo 2 face: Type 2 part with 7 contacts on top, separate stadium-shaped DC part below with DC+ and DC- concentric with its round ends), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IEC_62196_Type_2_(M,_DC,_CCS_Combo_2).svg, and "File:Combo-ccs-eu.svg" by GreatDrok (CC BY-SA 4.0; Type 2 CCS (Europe) connector: same arrangement, DC part about as wide as the Type 2 part), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Combo-ccs-eu.svg. The Type 2 part follows the plug-type-2 geometry (row ratios 0.70 and 0.869 of the pitch, flat top at 0.778 R), scaled to R 6.65; contacts are drawn smaller than in the drawings so the strokes do not merge.
